Name: Emet-Selch Downhill Project Compatibility Patch
Author: TJourney
Description:
Super simple patch to improve compatibility when both Emet Selch and Downhill Project are installed.


Requirements:
Stardew Valley v1.6
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13436]Emet-Selch - Custom NPC[/url] v1.3.2 Beta (and all of its prerequisites)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project - Expanded Map for Custom NPCs[/url] v1.0.12 (and all of its prerequisites)


Installation:
Installation is straightforward, just replace [i]"[CP] Emet-Selch - Custom NPC/[CP] Emet-Selch - Custom NPC BETA/assets/Maps/map_edits_Unlocked.json" [/i]with the one in the 7z file.
